title: 119에 전화하기: 무슨 일이세요?
objective: Describe an emergency to 119 and ask follow-up questions with -고요?.
summary: A caller reports a medical emergency to 119.
setting: A phone call to 119. The caller's father has suddenly collapsed at home, and a 119 dispatcher asks quick questions.

task.title: Report and respond
task.line: Use the dialogue and the expressions above to fill in, choose, put in order, and write your own short report.

words.meaning: And ...? Used to check one more thing right after another question. V/A-고요?, N(이)고요?, honorific -(으)시고요?
words.example: 다친 사람이 한 명이에요? 다른 사람은 괜찮고요?
words.exampleMeaning: Is one person hurt? And is everyone else OK?

words.meaning: to collapse, to fall down (from illness)
words.exampleMeaning: A man suddenly collapsed on the subway.

words.meaning: to hit, to bump (a body part)
words.exampleMeaning: I fell off my bike and hit my knee.

words.example: 칼에 손가락을 베여서 피가 많이 나요.
words.exampleMeaning: I cut my finger on a knife, and it's bleeding a lot.

dialogue.meaning: Yes, this is 119. What's the emergency?

dialogue.korean: 아버지가 갑자기 쓰러지셨어요. 여기 서교동 한빛아파트 105동 1203호예요.
dialogue.meaning: My father suddenly collapsed. We're at Hanbit Apartments, Building 105, Unit 1203, in Seogyo-dong.

dialogue.korean: 네, 구급차 바로 보내겠습니다. 환자분 의식은 있으세요?
dialogue.meaning: OK, I'm sending an ambulance right away. Is the patient conscious?
He doesn't answer when I call him.

dialogue.korean: 네, 숨은 쉬세요. 그런데 넘어지면서 머리를 부딪치셨어요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, he's breathing. But he hit his head when he fell.

exercises: Complete the dispatcher's follow-up question with -고요 using 하다: 상담원: 환자분이 열이 나세요? 기침도 ____?
Choose the right word: 상담원: 불이 어디에서 났어요? 신고자: 3층 부엌에서요. 상담원: 건물 안에 사람이 아직 (있고요 / 있을걸요 / 있어야지요)?
Put the call in order: (가) 친구가 의식이 없어요. 빨리 와 주세요. (나) 네, 119입니다. 무슨 일이세요? (다) 네, 숨은 쉬어요. (라) 숨은 쉬고요?
Answer in Korean in two sentences: You are at 한강공원. A woman fell off her bike. She is conscious, but her leg is bleeding a lot. Tell 119 what happened.
answers: Model answer: 한강공원에서 여자분이 자전거를 타다가 넘어졌어요. 의식은 있는데 다리에서 피가 많이 나요.
